## About
DM Auto Body is a family owned body shop at 14137 Oxnard Street in Van Nuys. We are the exclusive body shop for Miller Infiniti and Miller Nissan, and we work with drivers whether they're going through insurance or paying out of pocket.
You'll meet Ruben Perez, our manager, along with Pete Renteria, our assistant manager, and Alicia Garcia, who runs the office. Our customers have given us a 4.7 rating across 33 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn your trust the same way.

## Services
- Free estimates: Bring your car by and we'll look over the damage and tell you what it needs.
- Insurance claims: We help you through the insurance claim process so you can focus on getting back on the road.
- Shuttle service: We can give you a ride while your car is in the shop, within a 20 mile radius.
- After hour towing: If you need a tow outside shop hours, let us know.
- Detail: Interior, exterior and engine detailing. ($150)

## FAQ
Q: Can you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We handle insurance claims, and our contact form lets you choose either an insurance claim or out of pocket.

Q: Is towing available around the clock?
A: Towing and road service is available around the clock for Honda, Infiniti and Nissan. Ask for Frank when you call.

Q: Is there somewhere to wait?
A: Yes. We have refreshments, cable TV and free WiFi while you wait.
